packages.label: שֵׂכֶל וְנֵר הַדּוֹלֵק
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of the intellect (שֵׂכֶל) and its metaphorical inner structure: the eyes ARE the intellect ('עֵינֵי זֶה בְּחִינַת הַשֵּׂכֶל'), the sustained intellect IS a burning candle, and the moisture that rises to the brain IS the oil that feeds that candle. The Rebbe develops a unified lamp metaphor: the brain is the wick, the soul is the flame, the moisture (= oil) feeds it, and the eyes are the outward expression of this light. These three bechina pairs are all faces of the same essential domain — the intellect in its wholeness — and not a chain of cause-and-effect. The lungs sustain the moisture (an eitza), but the moisture being oil, the sekhel being a candle, and the eyes being sekhel are all parallel expressions of the same reality.

merge_notes.reason: Eyes and sekhel/chokhmah are a direct bechina pair (edge 1144): 'עֵינֵי זֶה בְּחִינַת הַשֵּׂכֶל' — the eyes in the verse Ps. 145:15 are the intellect. Both belong to the intellect-domain.

The sustaining of the intellect IS a burning candle (edge 2200): 'קִיּוּם הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נֵר דּוֹלֵק.' This is not a cause-effect but a parallel description — both the sustained sekhel and the burning candle are expressions of the same ignited-intellect reality.

The moisture that rises to the brain IS the oil (edge null-id): 'הַלַּחְלוּחִית הָעוֹלִים אֶל הַמֹּחַ, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁמֶן.' The moisture and the oil are two names for the same substance in the candle metaphor. Both belong to Package 1 because the candle (= sekhel) and its oil (= moisture/brain-nutrition) are the same essential domain: the intellect and what sustains it.

packages.label: אָדָם וְדִבּוּר
packages.reason: These two concepts share the essential nature of the human being defined by articulate speech: 'אָדָם שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת דִּבּוּר' (man is the bechina of speech). The power to cut letters from raw sound (חִתּוּךְ הַדִּבּוּר) is what distinguishes man from animal. They are not cause-and-effect — being a human does not produce speech as an external result; rather, speech IS what man IS. The same concept is expressed by the verse 'מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם': the mouth-speech-humanity complex is one integral reality.

packages.label: אֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל וּכְלוֹת הָעֵינַיִם
packages.reason: This pair is the evil mirror of Package 1. When the sekhel is not whole ('אֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל בִּשְׁלֵמוּת'), it is expressed by the verse 'כָּלוּ עֵינַי' (my eyes have failed — Ps. 69:4). Just as in Package 1 the eyes ARE the intellect in its positive aspect ('עֵינֵי כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ' = trusting through intellect), here the failed eyes express the intellect's absence. These are not cause-and-effect but the same negative reality seen from two angles: the deficiency of sekhel IS the failing of the eyes.
